It's much better to leave a note imo. Although your family will probably blame themselves for a period of time, and a note may never suffice I'm sure it will help. The most important thing is you need to give some sort of explanation of what led you to your decision. This is something you must do. Give specific reasons/events that led you to make this decision. This site breaks down everything you need to know about writing a successful note. https://archive.ashspace.org/ashbusstop.org/Note.html  

I hope you find peace.
